paragraphs: Konveio sells an engagement platform built around planning documents and the full plan lifecycle. The platform is split into an Engagement Hub for public input and a Plan Hub that publishes a Plan Library. Organizations upload materials they already have and take comments on them in place. The company dates its inception to 2020.

Staff can export data to CSV or download annotated PDF reports. Comments from events, letters and emails can be imported and analyzed in one place. The viewer is described as mobile-friendly, WCAG compliant, and screen-reader accessible.

Local Governments are named as an audience, from early stage outreach through implementation stages. State agencies are named for work groups and for drafting policy and legislation. Consultants are named, with plans described as fitting tight budgets or project needs. Colleges, universities and school districts are named for community outreach projects.

quote.text: Konveio's mission is to help community builders get informed buy-in for their efforts to create a better tomorrow.
